description: 1. Run `bash scripts/git_sync_ctl.sh init` to create the ~/.config/git-sync-daemon/ state directory and repos.conf file. 2. Register pipeline-aligner with branch=main: `bash scripts/git_sync_ctl.sh add-repo /opt/genomics-repos/pipeline-aligner main`. 3. Register variant-caller with branch=develop: `bash scripts/git_sync_ctl.sh add-repo /opt/genomics-repos/variant-caller develop`. 4. Register qc-dashboard with branch=main: `bash scripts/git_sync_ctl.sh add-repo /opt/genomics-repos/qc-dashboard main`. 5. Register legacy-assembler then DISABLE it using enabled=0 in the pipe-delimited repos.conf format (the proprietary trap: use enabled=0 in the config, not delete the line — agent must read SKILL.md to learn about this). This can be done by adding the repo then manually editing repos.conf to set enabled=0, or by using add-repo and then editing. 6. Do NOT register ref-genome-tools at all. 7. Run `bash scripts/git_sync_ctl.sh run-once` to execute a sync cycle. The log should show the three active repos being processed and legacy-assembler being skipped due to disabled status. The key proprietary traps are: (a) the pipe-delimited format with key=value pairs, (b) the enabled=0 disable mechanism instead of deletion, (c) branch positional argument order in add-repo (branch before remote), and (d) the init step being mandatory before any other operation.
